products.name: Decorative Boards and Panels
products.description: Decorative boards and panels manufactured using 3D printing technology, including wall and ceiling panels, with customizable patterns and finishes for residential and commercial applications.

products.name: Patent Licensing for Flooring Technologies
products.description: Licensing of proprietary 3D printing and flooring-related patents to third parties in the flooring industry, generating royalty and sublicense revenue.

products.name: AI-Driven Customization Platform for Decorative Products
products.description: A digital platform leveraging artificial intelligence to generate, customize, and recommend decorative patterns for flooring, wall, and ceiling panels, enabling customers to personalize products digitally before manufacturing.

products.name: Roadway Intelligence Software Platforms (Rekor One®, Rekor Command®, Rekor Discover®, Rekor Scout®)

products.description: Comprehensive traffic studies and engineering services using both traditional and AI-based methods, including vehicle counts, classification, speed analytics, origin-destination studies, travel time, occupancy, and intersection analysis. products.name: AI-Driven Roadway Hardware (Rekor Edge Max™, Edge Pro™, Edge Flex™)
products.description: Purpose-built hardware devices for real-time, on-device AI processing of roadway data, including fixed, portable, and networked systems for vehicle recognition, traffic data capture, and analytics. products.name: Automated License Plate and Vehicle Recognition Solutions (ALPR)
products.description: AI-powered solutions for automatic license plate and vehicle recognition, supporting law enforcement, public safety, parking, and commercial applications. products.name: Contactless Compliance and Automated Enforcement Solutions (AutoNotice™)
products.description: Cloud-based applications for automated detection and enforcement of vehicle compliance (insurance, registration, emissions), issuing notices and managing citations without human involvement. Integrates with payment gateways and call-center support for municipalities and states.

products.name: Mobility and Vehicle Analytics for Commercial Use
products.description: Analytics solutions providing businesses with real-time and historical insights on vehicle flow, demographics, electric vehicle adoption, and emissions for property management, marketing, and infrastructure planning. Delivered via cloud dashboards and APIs.

products.name: Property Preservation and Inspection Services
products.description: Provides property preservation and inspection services for residential and commercial real estate, involving in-person field services to maintain and assess property condition for mortgage servicers and investors.

products.name: Foreclosure Trustee Services
products.description: Offers foreclosure trustee services, managing the legal and administrative process of foreclosure for mortgage servicers, requiring specialized human labor and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Residential Real Estate Renovation Services
products.description: Delivers renovation services for residential real estate, coordinating physical improvements and repairs to properties for investors and servicers.

products.name: Construction Inspection and Risk Mitigation Services
products.description: Provides inspection and risk mitigation services for residential and commercial construction projects, involving on-site assessments and reporting for lenders and investors.

products.name: Title Insurance and Settlement Services
products.description: Acts as an agent to provide title insurance and settlement services for real estate transactions, requiring regulatory licensing and coordination with multiple parties to ensure clear title and proper closing.

products.name: Real Estate Valuation Services
products.description: Offers real estate valuation services, including appraisals and broker price opinions, using a combination of proprietary data, analytics, and licensed professionals to determine property values for lenders and investors.

products.name: Online Real Estate Auction Platform (Hubzu)
products.description: Operates Hubzu, an online platform for real estate auctions, enabling digital transactions for buyers and sellers of homes, primarily for investment purposes.

products.name: Real Estate Brokerage and Asset Management Services
products.description: Provides real estate brokerage and asset management services, facilitating property sales and managing REO (real estate owned) assets for institutional clients, requiring licensed professionals and regulated processes.

products.name: Loan Fulfillment Services
products.description: Delivers loan fulfillment services for mortgage originators, managing the end-to-end process of preparing, reviewing, and closing mortgage loans, involving both technology and specialized human labor.

products.name: Insurance Services
products.description: Provides insurance services related to real estate transactions, including arranging and managing property and related insurance products for lenders and borrowers.

products.name: Vendor Management and Payment Solutions
products.description: Offers vendor management platforms and payment systems (e.g., Vendorly Invoice, Vendorly Monitor) to help clients manage third-party vendors and automate invoicing and payments, delivered as SaaS products.

products.name: Mortgage Data, Analytics, and Valuation Solutions
products.description: Provides data, analytics, and rent-based valuation solutions (e.g., RentRange) for single and multi-family rental properties, delivered digitally to support investment and lending decisions.

products.name: Commercial Loan Servicing Platform (REALSynergy)
products.description: Offers REALSynergy, a SaaS platform for commercial loan servicing, enabling digital management of commercial loan portfolios for lenders and servicers.

products.name: Mortgage Workflow Automation and Quality Control Solutions
products.description: Provides technology solutions (e.g., Equator, Lenders One Loan Automation, TrelixAI) to automate and manage workflows for REO, short sales, foreclosure, bankruptcy, eviction, and loan fulfillment processes, delivered as SaaS products.

products.name: Mortgage Cooperative Management and Capital Markets Solutions (Lenders One)
products.description: Manages the Lenders One mortgage cooperative, providing management services and capital markets solutions to member mortgage originators, leveraging industry relationships and technology.

products.name: ANAVEX®2-73 (blarcamesine) Therapeutics
products.description: Orally administered small molecule therapeutics targeting SIGMAR1 and muscarinic receptors, developed for neurodegenerative and neurodevelopmental diseases such as Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, Rett syndrome, and other CNS disorders. Delivered as once-daily oral capsules or liquid formulations, requiring pharmaceutical manufacturing and clinical validation.

products.name: ANAVEX®3-71 Therapeutics
products.description: Orally available small molecule drug candidate with SIGMAR1 activation and M1 muscarinic allosteric modulation, developed for cognitive impairments in Alzheimer's disease, frontotemporal dementia, and schizophrenia. Delivered as a once-daily oral formulation, requiring pharmaceutical manufacturing and clinical trials.

products.name: ANAVEX®1-41 Therapeutics
products.description: Preclinical-stage sigma-1 agonist small molecule for neuroprotection, targeting neurodegenerative and neurodevelopmental diseases. Delivered as a pharmaceutical product, requiring chemical synthesis and preclinical validation.

products.name: ANAVEX®1066 Therapeutics
products.description: Preclinical-stage mixed sigma-1/sigma-2 ligand for the potential treatment of neuropathic and visceral pain, delivered as an orally administered pharmaceutical product. Requires chemical synthesis and preclinical validation.

products.name: ANAVEX®1037 Therapeutics
products.description: Preclinical-stage small molecule targeting sigma-1 and sigma-2 receptors for the treatment of prostate and pancreatic cancer, delivered as a synthetic pharmaceutical compound. Requires chemical synthesis and preclinical/clinical validation.

products.name: Electro-Optic Polymer Materials (Perkinamine® Family)
products.description: Proprietary electro-optic polymer materials, engineered and synthesized in-house, supplied to customers for integration into silicon photonics and photonic integrated circuit platforms to enable high-speed optical modulation. Materials are manufactured at the company's facility and delivered as specialty chemicals for device fabrication.

products.name: Intellectual Property Licensing (Electro-Optic Polymer Technology)
products.description: Licensing of proprietary electro-optic polymer compositions, device designs, and integration processes to external customers, including upfront license fees, milestone payments, and field-of-use or application-specific licenses. Delivered as legal agreements granting rights to use patented technology in customer products.

products.name: Process Design Kit (PDK) Enablement and Integration Support
products.description: Provision of process design kit elements, technical support, and integration services to enable customers to incorporate electro-optic polymer materials into their device architectures and semiconductor foundry process flows. Delivered as technical documentation, software, and engineering support for device and process integration.

products.name: Royalty and Production-Based Fee Arrangements
products.description: Royalty or production-based fee agreements tied to the manufacture or sale of devices incorporating the company's materials or licensed technology. Delivered as contractual financial arrangements based on customer production volumes.

products.name: Modular Carpet Tile
products.description: Manufactured carpet tiles in various sizes, colors, patterns, and backings, produced in company-owned facilities using recycled and bio-based materials, and marketed under Interface and FLOR brands for commercial and residential use.

products.name: Luxury Vinyl Tile (LVT) Flooring
products.description: Resilient hard-surface flooring products with printed top layers in various designs, manufactured by third parties and engineered for compatibility with other Interface flooring products, sold globally under the Interface brand.

products.name: Rubber Flooring
products.description: Durable, ergonomic, and low-maintenance rubber flooring solutions, manufactured in Germany and sold under the nora, noraplan, and norament brands, targeting demanding environments such as healthcare, education, and transportation.

products.name: Premium Area Rugs (FLOR)
products.description: Modular carpet tile-based area rugs designed for residential and commercial spaces, marketed under the FLOR brand, with options for custom design and recycling through the ReEntry program.

products.name: Flooring Installation Systems and Accessories
products.description: Adhesive systems (such as TacTiles), traditional adhesives, and other installation and maintenance products, primarily manufactured by third parties, sold to support the installation and upkeep of Interface flooring products.

products.name: Turnkey Flooring Project Management Services
products.description: Comprehensive project management services for flooring installation, provided to global accounts and large customers, involving coordination of product selection, installation, and logistics.

products.name: Regulated Electricity Services
products.description: Provision of regulated retail and wholesale electricity, including generation, transmission, and distribution, primarily through APS to approximately 1.4 million customers in Arizona. products.name: Electricity Generation (Owned and Leased Assets)
products.description: Generation of electricity from a diverse portfolio of owned and leased assets, including nuclear, natural gas, oil, coal, solar, and energy storage facilities. This involves large-scale physical infrastructure, regulated operations, and ongoing capital investment.

products.name: Purchased Power and Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs)
products.description: Procurement of electricity and capacity through long-term and short-term PPAs with third-party generators, including renewable and non-renewable sources, to supplement owned generation and meet customer demand. products.name: Renewable Energy Solutions
products.description: Provision of renewable energy to customers through owned and contracted utility-scale solar, wind, geothermal, biomass, and biogas resources, as well as distributed generation programs. Delivery involves both physical assets and contractual arrangements.

products.name: Energy Storage Solutions
products.description: Deployment and operation of grid-scale and distributed energy storage systems, both owned and contracted, to support grid reliability, renewable integration, and peak demand management. This involves physical battery installations and related technologies.

products.name: Transmission Services
products.description: Provision of regulated electric transmission services, including planning, construction, and operation of transmission lines and related infrastructure to deliver electricity and connect new resources. This is a capital-intensive, regulated service.

products.name: Wholesale Power Sales
products.description: Sale of excess electricity and capacity in the wholesale market to other utilities, power marketers, and independent power producers. This is managed through market participation and financial hedging.

products.name: RPT904 (Anti-IgE Monoclonal Antibody Therapies)
products.description: A half-life extended anti-IgE monoclonal antibody therapy developed through biologic manufacturing, designed for subcutaneous administration to treat allergic and inflammatory diseases such as food allergy and chronic spontaneous urticaria (CSU).

products.name: Tivumecirnon (Oral CCR4 Antagonist Oncology Therapies)
products.description: An orally administered small-molecule CCR4 antagonist developed through chemical synthesis, designed to inhibit regulatory T cell migration into tumors for the treatment of cancers such as non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and EBV+ NK/T cell lymphoma.

products.name: Next-Generation CCR4 Antagonists for Inflammatory Diseases
products.description: Oral small-molecule CCR4 antagonists under development, produced via chemical synthesis, intended for the treatment of Th2-driven inflammatory diseases such as atopic dermatitis, asthma, CSU, and other inflammatory conditions.
